tour.s1.p: Eleven styles, each with its tempos, scales, drum machines and synths. Some have variants: classic French Touch, Ed Banger or Myd; Detroit, minimal or industrial techno…
tour.s2.p: One sentence is enough: “a night in Paris, dirty bass, rising filters”. The art director (AI PC) suggests style, mood, tempo and settings; the server validates and clamps them before filling the form. Without AI, a local suggestion takes over.
tour.s3.p: Duration from 20 s to 4 h, mood, key. Advanced shows the exact values the style will use; change one and it is remembered for that style. Same seed = same track.
tour.s4.p: Rendering happens on the server: a few seconds for a track, a few minutes for a one-hour mix. The background pulses with the music; WAV, MP3 and per-instrument MIDI are ready to download.
tour.s5.p: For each track: YouTube thumbnail and video (animated background, spectrum, chapters), FR + EN titles and descriptions, split a long mix into tracks. A Windows PC can speed up videos.

start.lead: soundtube is a studio that runs on your server. It composes, plays and masters; a Windows PC can render videos and an AI PC can act as art director. Here is the circuit, then a five-step tour.
start.youBody: Studio, style pages, Admin. An account is required to create and use the library.
start.stepTheory: Theory — scale, mode, progression from the seed
start.stepFiles: Files — WAV · MP3 · MIDI · YouTube video
